design: non-tautological inertia triad on F1-3D free capacity
numeric_method: analytic Gaussian self-energy + boost model + R3 ray map; optional grid SOR in sandbox_r4_inertia.py
U_formula: s kappa M^2 / (8 pi sigma sqrt(pi))  [F1 infinite-space Gaussian self-energy]

boost_model.model: E(v)=U/sqrt(1-v^2/c^2) free-field energy boost (hyperbolic free capacity / EM analog)
boost_model.tautology_check: does NOT use F=ma; uses free-field energy–velocity relation only
boost_model.note: m_est→U/c² as v→0; finite-v includes O(v²) relativistic corrections

ray_model.note: R3 weak Born defl~-2 alpha_eff M/b; m_ray≡m_ledger by F1 lensing construction

pair_force_analytic.formula: F = s kappa M1 M2 / (4 pi R^2)
pair_force_analytic.note: free-medium force from energy gradient; not used as F=ma mass extractor

renormalization_R1.interpretation: Free constitutive s chosen so free-field self-energy U equals bound ledger Mc² closes triad (A route R1). Documents required calibration — not a dynamics-free proof of coefficient 1.

j5.note: Raw: m_ray=m_ledger PASS; m_field=U/c² ≪ m_ledger (form factor 0.141). Boost=field PASS. Full raw three-way FAIL without renorm. With s_renorm, triad closes.

verdict.J5_operational_status: PARTIAL — ray–ledger closed; inertia–ledger needs R1 renorm or E_star:=U
verdict.summary: Non-tautological tests: (1) free-field unlock energy U; (2) boost E(v)=U/γ free-field model m_boost=U/c²; (3) m_ray from R3 F1 map. No F:=ma tautology. Raw J5 three-way FAIL because Gaussian self-energy form factor U/Mc²≈0.141. Ray–ledger PASS. R1 free-constant renormalization closes triad. Parent re-run grid: python3 sandbox_r4_inertia.py --N 24

FOR_A: Form factor U/Mc²=1/(8πσ√π)*M = M/(8πσ√π)≈0.141; s_renorm≈7.07 closes U=Mc² — formalize R1
FOR_C: J5 raw FAIL field=ledger; PASS ray=ledger + boost=field; renorm path for full J5
FOR_D: round4_inertia_triad.tsv for scoring; independent m_boost≠m_ledger raw
